title: joyous's type check passes, so code-check can run there
why: From the joyous c127 lane's report, Oct 28 03:24 CDT (orchestrator outbox): joyous has 132 tsc errors, so the shared code-check would go red on arrival.
note: Next cloud lane, in joyous (grant: waiting page item 2, a, Oct 28 02:31 CDT; read joyous's open branches and PRs first, touch no file they change): add @types/node and the Cloudflare worker types, then fix the strict string|undefined errors in src/lib/env.ts, middleware.ts, api/tour.ts and the tests. Exclude candidates for code-check: archive/files/, archive/media-manifest.csv, wrangler.jsonc. Red first: tsc --noEmit on joyous main. Done when tsc --noEmit is clean on joyous main. Needs no answer. Port: this is joyous's part of c127. Placed after c168, ahead of c127's joyous row (triage 10, Oct 28): c127 joyous waits on it. From c168's lane (fixtures, not joyous itself): with no node_modules, tsc and astro-check both go red on an Astro repo (TS6053, TS2307), so joyous's workflow installs its dependencies before code-check; triage's pick, Oct 28, reversible: the repo knows its package manager, so the action stays install-free. Even with node_modules, plain tsc on an Astro tsconfig may stay red on a .ts file that imports a .astro file (TS2307); measure it on joyous. If it is, skipping tsc in an astro.config folder changes a gate's verdict and needs its own step. Done Oct 28: joyous#48 (132 to 17 errors), then joyous#49 (3739cf1d): tsc --noEmit at 0 errors on joyous main, so the .astro import concern did not arise there. Side fix: score.test.ts timeouts had been silently ignored by node:test; they now sit in the options argument.
